question: Gaan-Ngai is a five-day festival primarily celebrated in which part of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**North-Eastern.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gaan-Ngai **is a post-harvest festival celebrated by the **Zeliangrong tribe of Manipur, Nagaland**, and** Assam **in North-Eastern India.
 
• The festival usually falls in **December or January** and is a time of feasting, dancing, and merry-making.
 
• The festival marks the end of the** old year **and the beginning of a** new one** and is dedicated to the deity **Tingkao Ragwang**, who is believed to bring prosperity and good fortune.
 
• The festival involves rituals such as the **burning of bamboo torches,** offering of **rice beer** to the deity, and playing traditional musical instruments like gongs and drums.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Famous festivals of Northern India are **Kumbh Mela, Pushkar Mela, Desert Festival, Rann Utsav, and Sindhu Darshan.**
 
• Western India is known for its vibrant culture and festivals like **Diwali, Holi, and Navratri.**
 
• Southern India is home to many unique festivals like **Pongal, Onam, and Dussehra.**
